finding: All color, spacing, and typography values use --hx-* token references with hardcoded fallbacks; no bare hex values in non-fallback positions.
Three-tier cascade is correctly applied throughout: component token -> semantic token -> hardcoded value fallback at every var() call.

Inverted mode references --hx-overlay-white-15, --hx-overlay-white-20, --hx-overlay-white-25, --hx-overlay-white-50, --hx-overlay-white-70 — none of these are defined in tokens.json (defined steps are 8, 10, 20, 30, 40 only).
recommendation: Add overlay.white.15, .25, .50, .70 entries to packages/hx-tokens/src/tokens.json, or remap to nearest defined steps (white-20, white-30, white-40).

finding: All variant-level overrides correctly set component tokens (--hx-button-bg etc.) which are consumed via the base rule using two-level fallback. Cascade is clean.

CSS parts (button, prefix, label, suffix, spinner) are exposed on the native element for consumer ::part() targeting. Component-level tokens (--hx-button-bg, --hx-button-color, --hx-button-border-radius, etc.) are well-named.
No prefers-color-scheme media queries in component styles; dark mode is fully delegated to the token layer via CSS custom property overrides. The design is correct.
Complete @media (forced-colors: active) block uses ButtonFace, ButtonText, GrayText, Highlight system keywords; forced-color-adjust: none is applied where needed.
All component-level overrides use the --hx-button-* namespace consistently; no cross-component token pollution.

--hx-touch-target-min is referenced in 18+ components (hx-button, hx-checkbox, hx-switch, hx-dialog, hx-icon-button, hx-toggle-button, hx-carousel, hx-tag, hx-toast, hx-date-picker, hx-radio, hx-badge, hx-split-panel, hx-data-table, hx-clinical-status, hx-drawer, hx-code-snippet, hx-banner) but is NOT defined in tokens.json. Only --hx-size-touch-target exists. Fallback hardcoded value 2.75rem prevents visual breakage but theming is broken.
recommendation: Add a touch-target-min token to packages/hx-tokens/src/tokens.json under size (value: 2.75rem), or add an alias --hx-touch-target-min pointing to --hx-size-touch-target.

finding: --hx-touch-target-size (used in hx-alert, hx-banner) is also not defined in tokens.json alongside --hx-touch-target-min. Two variants of the same concept with inconsistent naming exist across the component set.
recommendation: Standardize to one token (--hx-touch-target-min or --hx-touch-target-size) and add it to tokens.json. Update all component references to the canonical name.

finding: --hx-duration-spinner is referenced in hx-button, hx-spinner, hx-progress-ring, hx-menu-item for animation durations but does not exist in tokens.json. Duration tokens defined are: instant, fast, normal, slow, slower, reduced. All spinner animations fall back to hardcoded values.
recommendation: Add duration.spinner to packages/hx-tokens/src/tokens.json with value '750ms' (the most common fallback used).

finding: --hx-opacity-muted is referenced in hx-button (spinner reduced-motion fallback) but does not exist in tokens.json. Defined opacity tokens are: 0, 5, 10, 25, 50, 75, 90, 100, disabled, overlay. There is no 'muted' key.
recommendation: Add opacity.muted to packages/hx-tokens/src/tokens.json (suggest value: '0.6' matching the hardcoded fallback in hx-button).

finding: hx-card uses --hx-lift-md but the token generated from tokens.json is --hx-transform-lift-md (path: transform.lift-md). The token prefix is wrong — referencing a non-existent name means the hardcoded fallback (-2px) is always used.
recommendation: Change var(--hx-lift-md, -2px) to var(--hx-transform-lift-md, -2px) in hx-card.styles.ts to reference the correct generated token name.

finding: All color, border, spacing, shadow, and font tokens are used correctly with proper fallback chains. Hardcoded values in fallback positions match the token values from tokens.json.

No explicit dark mode token overrides documented in component — relies entirely on consumer overriding --hx-card-bg and --hx-card-color. The semantic fallback colors (neutral-0, neutral-200, neutral-600) will not adapt to dark mode without consumer or hx-theme intervention.
recommendation: Document in JSDoc/Storybook that dark mode requires either hx-theme or consumer-level --hx-card-* overrides. Consider if a dark-mode aware default is needed.

finding: @media (forced-colors: active) block correctly sets border and actions border-top to CanvasText system color.

Component tokens --hx-card-bg, --hx-card-color, --hx-card-border-color, --hx-card-border-radius, --hx-card-padding, --hx-card-gap are available but --hx-card-heading-color and --hx-card-body-color are not independently addressable without overriding the shared --hx-card-color.
recommendation: Add --hx-card-heading-color and --hx-card-body-color component tokens to allow granular theming of heading vs body text independently.

finding: Uses correct private custom property pattern (_bg, _color etc.) at :host level to resolve three-tier cascade once; subsequent rules consume private properties, avoiding redundant cascade resolution.

--hx-overlay-neutral-12 is referenced in the listbox box-shadow fallback. This token EXISTS in tokens.json (overlay.neutral.12). However, the token path generates --hx-overlay-neutral-12 which is correct. No issue here.

--hx-space-px is used with fallback value '2px' in the chevron positioning, but the token value is '1px'. The hardcoded fallback is inconsistent with the token definition, which will cause a 1px visual discrepancy when tokens are not loaded.
recommendation: Change var(--hx-space-px, 2px) to var(--hx-space-px, 1px) to match the token value in tokens.json.

finding: Comprehensive forced-colors block covering trigger, listbox, options, error state, disabled states, labels and help text using correct system color keywords.

Multiple var() calls for --hx-space-*, --hx-font-size-*, --hx-color-* and --hx-size-* lack hardcoded fallbacks (e.g. var(--hx-space-1) with no fallback, var(--hx-opacity-disabled) with no fallback). This breaks progressive enhancement when the token sheet fails to load.
recommendation: Add hardcoded fallbacks to every var(--hx-*) call in hx-number-input.styles.ts. Priority: var(--hx-space-1, 0.25rem), var(--hx-opacity-disabled, 0.5), var(--hx-border-width-thin, 1px), var(--hx-font-size-sm, 0.875rem).

finding: No hardcoded color values outside of var() fallback positions. Token usage is complete for semantic color properties.

Complete forced-colors block with Field, FieldText, ButtonFace, ButtonText, GrayText, CanvasText, Highlight, HighlightText, LinkText system keywords. Error state mapped to LinkText for maximum visibility.
All structural colors and sizes use token references with proper fallbacks. The comment noting WCAG contrast ratios confirms accessibility-aware token choices.
--hx-overlay-white-10 (used in toggle hover) IS defined in tokens.json (overlay.white.10 = rgba(255,255,255,0.10)). The known signal about this token being undefined is incorrect — it is defined.

Component uses neutral-900 base which is inherently dark-mode appropriate for a sidebar. Token overrides (--hx-side-nav-bg etc.) allow full light/dark theming without any hardcoded prefers-color-scheme queries.
Forced-colors block overrides all border colors to CanvasText and toggle to ButtonText with explicit 1px solid border.
--hx-overlay-white-8 (used in hover background fallback) IS defined in tokens.json (overlay.white.8 = rgba(255,255,255,0.08)). Token reference is valid.
Variant colors correctly set component tokens (--hx-alert-bg, --hx-alert-border-color, etc.) per variant. Base rule consumes them. Proper 3-tier cascade.

Alert variant color fallbacks use non-standard hex values: info-500 fallback is #3b82f6 (correct), but info-800 fallback is #1a3a4a and success-800 is #065f46 — these do not match the corresponding token values in tokens.json (info-800 = #0C4A6E, success-800 = #14532D).
recommendation: Audit all hardcoded fallback hex values in hx-alert.styles.ts against tokens.json to ensure fallbacks exactly match token values. Discrepancies mean behavior differs when tokens fail to load.

finding: Forced-colors block covers base, accent, icon, and close button with CanvasText and ButtonText system keywords.
All properties use token cascade correctly. FocusMixin integration with :host([focused]) and :host([focused-visible]) attribute hooks provides correct theming API for consumers targeting host state.

Every var(--hx-*) call includes a hardcoded fallback. Multiple fallback chains follow the three-tier pattern correctly (e.g. var(--hx-input-focus-ring-color, var(--hx-focus-ring-color, var(--hx-color-primary-400, #60a5fa)))).
Comprehensive forced-colors block using Field, FieldText, ButtonText, GrayText, Highlight, CanvasText, LinkText system keywords. Disables opacity on disabled host to prevent double-stacking.
Token usage is consistent throughout. Container width uses --hx-container-narrow which exists (48rem). Dialog shadow references --hx-shadow-xl with no fallback — minor missing fallback.
recommendation: Add hardcoded fallback to var(--hx-dialog-shadow, var(--hx-shadow-xl)) — change to var(--hx-dialog-shadow, var(--hx-shadow-xl, 0 20px 25px -5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 8px 10px -6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1))).

finding: All referenced tokens (--hx-z-index-modal, --hx-duration-normal, --hx-easing-out, --hx-border-radius-lg, --hx-shadow-xl, --hx-container-narrow) exist in tokens.json and generate correct custom property names.
Forced-colors block adds 1px solid CanvasText border to dialog panel and overrides header/footer border colors. Close button gets ButtonText color and border.
Uses CSS custom property inheritance between hx-tabs and hx-tab via private --_tab-indicator-* props. Clean cascade design.
All referenced tokens (--hx-color-primary-500/600, --hx-color-neutral-*, --hx-font-weight-*, --hx-transition-fast, --hx-focus-ring-*) exist in tokens.json.
Forced-colors block applies ButtonFace/ButtonText for default and Highlight/HighlightText for selected state. Focus uses 3px Highlight outline matching Windows HCM conventions.

References --hx-size-4-5 (1.125rem), --hx-size-5-5 (1.375rem), --hx-size-6-5 (1.625rem), --hx-size-3-5 (0.875rem) — none of these fractional size tokens are defined in tokens.json. The size token set only includes integer steps (4,5,6,7,8,9,10,11,12,14,16,20). All fall back to hardcoded values.
recommendation: Add fractional size tokens to packages/hx-tokens/src/tokens.json: size['1-5']=0.375rem, size['3-5']=0.875rem, size['4-5']=1.125rem, size['5-5']=1.375rem, size['6-5']=1.625rem. These are needed by the switch track/thumb sizing system.

finding: Color, focus ring, label, and error colors all properly use the three-tier pattern. All non-size tokens use --hx-switch-* component namespace as outer tier.
Complete forced-colors block: track uses ButtonFace+ButtonText border, checked state uses Highlight, disabled states use GrayText. No tokens fall through in HCM.
Full three-tier cascade with --hx-checkbox-* component tokens feeding from semantic --hx-color-primary-* and --hx-color-error-* tokens.
Thorough forced-colors block including checked/indeterminate, error, and disabled states for both box and label. Uses Highlight/HighlightText/LinkText/GrayText system keywords correctly.

--hx-duration-slow is referenced as the pulse animation fallback via var(--hx-badge-pulse-duration, var(--hx-duration-slow, 2s)) — however tokens.json defines duration.slow as '300ms' not '2000ms'. The fallback chain is logically broken: if --hx-badge-pulse-duration is not set, it resolves to 300ms (a blink), not the intended 2s.
recommendation: The hardcoded final fallback '2s' will protect against visual breakage, but the intermediate --hx-duration-slow should not be used here. Replace with var(--hx-badge-pulse-duration, 2s) and remove the intermediate semantic token from this chain.

finding: --hx-space-0-5 (0.125rem) and --hx-space-1-5 (0.375rem) are referenced in badge padding but are NOT defined in tokens.json. Hardcoded fallbacks protect rendering but these spacing tokens cannot be themed.
recommendation: Add space['0-5'] = '0.125rem' and space['1-5'] = '0.375rem' to packages/hx-tokens/src/tokens.json. Multiple components (hx-badge, hx-tag, hx-nav, hx-stat, hx-switch, hx-slider) rely on these missing fractional space tokens.

finding: References --hx-size-1 (0.25rem), --hx-size-1-5 (0.375rem), --hx-size-3 (0.75rem), --hx-size-4 (1rem), --hx-size-5 (1.25rem) for track heights and thumb sizes. Of these, --hx-size-1 and --hx-size-1-5 are NOT defined in tokens.json (size scale starts at 4). --hx-size-3 is also NOT defined.
recommendation: Add size['1']=0.25rem, size['1-5']=0.375rem, size['3']=0.75rem, size['2']=0.5rem to packages/hx-tokens/src/tokens.json to complete the size scale. These sub-1rem sizes are widely needed.

finding: Track, fill, and thumb colors use component tokens with proper semantic fallbacks. Focus ring follows the standard three-tier pattern.
Forced-colors block sets track to ButtonFace+ButtonText border, fill to Highlight, thumb to ButtonText. The native input restores outline:revert for keyboard focus in HCM.

The z-index fallback in var(--hx-top-nav-z-index, var(--hx-z-index-sticky, 1000)) uses 1000 as the hardcoded fallback, but --hx-z-index-sticky is defined as 1100 in tokens.json. The fallback 1000 matches --hx-z-index-dropdown instead, creating a z-index collision risk.
recommendation: Change the hardcoded final fallback from 1000 to 1100 to match the --hx-z-index-sticky token value: var(--hx-top-nav-z-index, var(--hx-z-index-sticky, 1100)).

finding: Color and spacing tokens are consistently used. Mobile animation uses --hx-duration-fast correctly.
Forced-colors block handles nav border, mobile toggle border, and collapsible divider with CanvasText/ButtonText system keywords.

Variant color fallbacks in .toast--success, .toast--warning, .toast--danger, .toast--info use specific color stop values (e.g. #16a34a for success-600) that differ from the token values in tokens.json (--hx-color-success-600 = #15803D). This creates a visual discrepancy when tokens are unavailable.
recommendation: Audit all hardcoded fallback hex values in toast variant rules against tokens.json. Update #16a34a to #15803d (success-600) and #f59e0b to #D97706 (warning-500) to maintain consistency.

finding: Forced-colors block adds CanvasText border to toast and ButtonText/ButtonText-border to close button. Adequate coverage.

--hx-overlay-white-15 is referenced in 3 components (hx-button inverted secondary/tertiary/outline hover, hx-button inverted ghost hover uses --hx-overlay-white-20) but --hx-overlay-white-15 is NOT defined in tokens.json. Defined white overlay steps: 8, 10, 20, 30, 40.
recommendation: Add overlay.white['15'] = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)' to packages/hx-tokens/src/tokens.json.

finding: --hx-overlay-white-25 referenced in hx-button (inverted tertiary hover), --hx-overlay-white-50 in hx-button (inverted focus ring), --hx-overlay-white-70 in hx-button (inverted secondary/outline border) — none defined in tokens.json.
recommendation: Add overlay.white['25'], overlay.white['50'], overlay.white['70'] to packages/hx-tokens/src/tokens.json with values rgba(255,255,255,0.25), rgba(255,255,255,0.50), rgba(255,255,255,0.70) respectively.

finding: --hx-space-0-5 (0.125rem) and --hx-space-1-5 (0.375rem) are referenced in hx-badge, hx-tag, hx-nav, hx-stat, hx-switch, hx-slider across 8+ style files but are NOT defined in tokens.json. The space scale jumps from space-0 (0) and space-px (1px) directly to space-1 (0.25rem).
recommendation: Add space['0-5'] = '0.125rem' and space['1-5'] = '0.375rem' to packages/hx-tokens/src/tokens.json to fill the gaps in the spacing scale.

finding: --hx-size-1 (0.25rem), --hx-size-1-5 (0.375rem), --hx-size-3 (0.75rem), --hx-size-3-5 (0.875rem), --hx-size-4-5 (1.125rem), --hx-size-5-5 (1.375rem), --hx-size-6-5 (1.625rem) are all referenced by hx-switch, hx-slider and others but none exist in tokens.json. The size scale begins at size-4 (1rem).
recommendation: Add the missing fractional and sub-1rem size tokens to packages/hx-tokens/src/tokens.json. Required additions: size['1']=0.25rem, size['1-5']=0.375rem, size['2']=0.5rem, size['3']=0.75rem, size['3-5']=0.875rem, size['4-5']=1.125rem, size['5-5']=1.375rem, size['6-5']=1.625rem.

finding: No prefers-color-scheme media queries found in any component styles file. Dark mode is correctly delegated entirely to the token layer via CSS custom property overrides. The hx-tokens package generates darkMediaCSS and darkManualCSS for both media-query and [data-theme='dark'] switching.

The three-tier cascade (component token -> semantic token -> primitive fallback) is consistently applied across the most complex components (hx-button, hx-select, hx-text-input, hx-checkbox, hx-switch). The hx-select component uses the advanced private property pattern at :host level to resolve once, which is architecturally superior.
recommendation: Promote the hx-select :host private property resolution pattern (--_bg: var(--hx-select-bg, var(--hx-color-neutral-0, #fff))) as the standard pattern in the component authoring guide for complex components with many token properties.

finding: Forced-colors support is present in all interactive components reviewed (hx-button, hx-card, hx-alert, hx-text-input, hx-number-input, hx-select, hx-checkbox, hx-switch, hx-tabs, hx-tab, hx-side-nav, hx-top-nav, hx-slider, hx-toast, hx-dialog). This is comprehensive coverage meeting WCAG 2.1 AA for Windows High Contrast mode.

The tokens.json file defines dark-mode overrides only for: color.text, color.surface, color.border, color.focus-ring, color.selection, color.error-text, color.success-text, body, shadow. Dark overrides for semantic interactive state tokens (hover, focus, active overlays) are absent, requiring consumers to manage them manually.
recommendation: Add dark mode overrides for overlay tokens in the dark section of tokens.json to provide complete theming support without consumer intervention.

finding: Focus ring tokens (--hx-focus-ring-color, --hx-focus-ring-width, --hx-focus-ring-offset, --hx-focus-ring-opacity, --hx-focus-ring-style, --hx-focus-spacing-offset) are all correctly defined and match actual usage patterns in component styles.

Semantic color tokens for borders (--hx-color-border-default, --hx-color-border-subtle, --hx-color-border-strong, --hx-color-border-focus), surfaces (--hx-color-surface-default, --hx-color-surface-raised, --hx-color-surface-sunken, --hx-color-surface-overlay), and text hierarchy (--hx-color-text-primary through --hx-color-text-link-active) are all defined and complete.

--hx-focus-ring-opacity is referenced in focus-within box-shadow without a hardcoded fallback: calc(var(--hx-focus-ring-opacity) * 100%). If the token fails to resolve, the color-mix() expression collapses and the focus ring disappears.
recommendation: Add hardcoded fallback: change var(--hx-focus-ring-opacity) to var(--hx-focus-ring-opacity, 0.25) in the color-mix() expressions in hx-number-input.styles.ts.

finding: hx-spinner uses --hx-duration-spinner for its animation duration but this token is not defined in tokens.json. The fallback 750ms works but the token cannot be themed.
recommendation: Add duration.spinner = '750ms' to packages/hx-tokens/src/tokens.json.

finding: hx-progress-ring uses --hx-duration-spinner (1400ms fallback) for its rotation and dash animations. Same undefined token issue as hx-spinner and hx-button.
recommendation: Same fix as hx-spinner: add duration.spinner to tokens.json. Note the progress-ring uses 1400ms as fallback vs 750ms in hx-spinner — these should be reconciled to the same value.

finding: Hardcoded fallback hex value mismatches found across multiple components: hx-alert uses #3b82f6 for info-500 (token value is #0284C7), and #1a3a4a for info-800 (token value is #0C4A6E). hx-toast uses #16a34a for success-600 (token is #15803D), #f59e0b for warning-500 (token is #D97706). hx-badge uses #eab308 for warning-500 (token is #D97706). These mismatches cause subtle visual bugs when tokens are unavailable.
recommendation: Run a systematic audit of all hardcoded fallback values against tokens.json and correct mismatches. Consider adding a CI check that validates fallback values match their parent token definition.

finding: 97 component TypeScript files expose CSS parts via part= attributes, enabling ::part() consumer customization. Component-level token namespaces are consistently used (--hx-button-*, --hx-card-*, --hx-select-* etc.) providing a well-defined theming API surface.
recommendation: Create a master theming API document listing all component tokens and CSS parts for consumer documentation (Storybook autodocs partially covers this via CEM).

finding: 13 undefined token references identified across the library: 4 missing overlay-white steps (15, 25, 50, 70), 7 missing size fractional tokens (1, 1-5, 3, 3-5, 4-5, 5-5, 6-5), 2 missing space fractional tokens (0-5, 1-5), 1 missing duration token (spinner), 1 missing opacity token (muted), 1 missing touch-target naming alignment (touch-target-min vs size-touch-target), 1 wrong token name (lift-md vs transform-lift-md in hx-card). All fall back to hardcoded values but cannot be themed.
recommendation: Create a single tokens.json patch PR that adds all 13 missing tokens before 3.0.0 release. This is a pre-release blocker as consumers cannot theme these values via the documented token API.
